score.method: Each finding costs 30 (critical) / 10 (warning) / 2 (info) points, scaled from 50 % to 100 % by the share of the dataset it affects (100 % at 10 % or more); the score is 100 minus the sum, floored at 0. The score is reported next to the verdict and never decides it.

findings.title: Column 'T_max' has no unit
findings.detail: 'T_max' is declared without a unit, so a value cannot be checked against physical bounds or converted.
findings.fix: Add the unit of 'T_max' to the manifest.
